part.Name: Description
part.Short: His chassis is illuminated with the artifacts of life: dirt smeared over his undercarriage, dead leaves pinned by bolts to his hardpoints, lichen angling for sunlight on his armatures. A hat crumpled like cheese cloth shades the glass lune of his sensor array, where with a dim but golden iris he sees, and muses.
